page.overview:
What is Screaming Suicide?

Screaming Suicide is the third track off of Metallica's eleventh studio album 72 Seasons.

It is also the second single from the album. The song was written and composed by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich and Robert Trujillo.

Welcome to this life Born into the fight Here to claim your dream Look you in the eye Patch the broken sky Craving dopamine Then my voice appears Teaching you of fears Are you good enough? You don't recognize Head is full of lies You should just give up

Listen well, better listen well Listen well, better listen well
